## Context / Problem
Slice C1 (ticket 29a9-3cf7-3ded-42d8) recorded 3 below-seam ambient config/credential reads in the MCP server (mcp_server.py, _mcp_auth.py), incl. the deferred RP-04 S5 MCP load_config()-per-call cutover as entries in `scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS`. RP-04 is not complete while these ambient reads sit below the approved composition/credential/backend seams enforced by `scripts/check_config_ownership.py`. Parent: 075b-1479-dcb7-40ab.

Affected files (relative to repo root):
  - `src/rebar/_mcp_auth.py` (below-seam auth-secret reads cut to the seam)
  - `src/rebar/mcp_server.py` (below-seam gate/config/proxy-secret reads cut to the seam)
  - `src/rebar/config.py` (adds the three new owned composition-root resolvers this change introduces)
  - `scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py` (removes the drained MCP `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` rows)

## Outcome
Every below-seam read in the two MCP files is CUT to compose through the approved composition-root seam. The chosen mechanism: this change ADDS three new owned composition-root resolvers to `config.py` (new `mcp_gate` / `compose_config` / `read_secret_env` helpers — they do not exist at the base and are introduced by this change), and the MCP consumers are ROUTED THROUGH those new resolvers, which is where ambient config/secret reads are legitimately owned. This PRESERVES the exact per-request semantics the MCP gate/auth docstrings promise (no per-request->startup-frozen change) — there is NO behavioral delta. The MCP `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` entries are removed. `python scripts/check_config_ownership.py` reports zero findings for these paths with those entries gone and no path-glob exception. The subsystem's behavioral suites stay green, unmodified.

## Plan
1. Add three new owned composition-root resolvers to `config.py` (which is already a composition root): `mcp_gate(attr, *, fail)` (typed bool gate, fail-closed on ConfigError), `compose_config() -> Config` (process-root config entry), and `read_secret_env(env_name) -> str` (secret VALUE resolved at the boundary, in-memory only, "" on unset/empty). These do not exist at the base; this change introduces them.
2. Route the below-seam `load_config()` calls (`mcp_server.py` L422/591/735) and the auth-secret `os.environ.get` reads (`_mcp_auth.py` L411/658/760, `mcp_server.py` L646) through the new `config.py` resolvers (`mcp_gate`/`compose_config`/`read_secret_env`), so the consumers RECEIVE composed config/secret values from the composition root instead of reading ambient config/env below the seam. Per-request resolution semantics are preserved (no startup freeze); secret VALUES stay in-memory only and fail-closed on unset/empty is unchanged.
3. Remove the corresponding MCP entries from `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` in `scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py`.
4. Run `python scripts/check_config_ownership.py` and the subsystem behavioral suites (tests/interfaces/facades MCP suites, tests/unit MCP/auth suites); keep green.

## Testing (RED -> GREEN)
- Held-out test `tests/scripts/test_mcp_server_seam_clean_heldout.py` asserts `check_config_ownership.check(check_config_ownership.REPO_ROOT)` returns no finding string containing any of the listed paths, AND that `config_ownership_exceptions.LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` contains zero entries whose `path` is one of the listed files. RED now (entries present + reads below seam).
- The subsystem behavioral suites (tests/interfaces/facades MCP suites, tests/unit MCP/auth suites) stay green after the cutover — they are the correctness oracle the AST gate supplements.
- No behavioral delta: the MCP/auth behavioral suites (179 tests) pass UNMODIFIED before and after the cutover.

## Compatibility / rollback
No stored ticket/event/binding format changes. The new `config.py` resolvers are additive; the cutover is a pure routing change with no behavioral delta, so rollback is reverting the single change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] No direct ambient config/credential read, backend reload, or configurable default remains below the approved seam in the 2 listed MCP files; each is cut-to-seam through the new owned `config.py` resolvers.
- [x] The `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` entries for these files are removed from `scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py`, and `python scripts/check_config_ownership.py` passes with no path-glob exception (proven by the held-out `test_mcp_server_seam_clean_heldout.py`).
- [x] The subsystem behavioral suites (tests/interfaces/facades MCP suites, tests/unit MCP/auth suites) pass after the cutover, unmodified; there is no behavioral delta (per-request semantics preserved).
